audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the packet and with the mirror audit: rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 were wrong in BOTH layers (full phases[].side and content win[]).
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Ryze at 55.33% over 694 games, and the ryze-side mirror audit already locked that chart. Ryze cannot win Level 6 on a page that then says Vanguard's Edge walls off his kite, and he cannot lose the 2-item stage while the same page calls him a hard scaler.
audit.corrected: Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Ryze's stage and the 2-item stage as Irelia's — the exact inverse of both kits.
audit.why: Vanguard's Edge (125/105/85s) creates terrain behind a champion with no dash, which is Irelia's single best window against Ryze. Realm Warp is 180/160/140s with no combat CC, so it is a map tool, not a lane spike. Ryze's spike is mana/AP scaling at two-plus items, where Rune Prison is free-cast.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Irelia's; the 2-item stage is the flip to Ryze.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate ability errors repeated across the page: (a) Ryze's root is called his E — it is Rune Prison (W), and Spell Flux (E) is the debuff that upgrades the slow into a root; (b) Defiant Dance (W) is presented as a way to tank Ryze's burst; (c) Ryze is repeatedly credited with a shield, and Irelia's passive with MR shred.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rune Prison (W, 615 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) slows, and roots only if the target has Flux on it. Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge — Ryze's damage is magic, so holding W for his burst is advice for a window that does not exist. Ryze's kit contains no shield anywhere. Irelia's passive grants stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage at max stacks, not magic-resist shred.
audit.corrected: Root named as Rune Prison and gated behind Spell Flux; Defiant Dance stated as physical-only and explicitly useless against Ryze; shield claims removed; passive restated as attack speed plus on-hit damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice was vague — 'track Rune Prison' with no number.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and 10.5s at rank 2; Overload's 5s base is reset by every other cast, so the punishable cooldown is only ever the W.
audit.corrected: Real Rune Prison numbers written into the level 2, level 3 and early-game text.

edits.before: Ryze comes online: free-cast Q roots and his shield let him burst you from range as a raid-boss. Avoid extended fights and close the game before this window.
edits.after: Ryze comes online: mana scaling lets him free-cast Rune Prison and chain Overload into you from range. Avoid extended fights and close the game before this window.

edits.before: Level 1 you only have Q and no stun, so respect his Q poke and farm with Bladesurge off the wave — don't dash in for a single auto and eat a free root. The trade flips at Level 3: once you have E you can drop the blades, stun him, Q-reset onto the E-mark, and W-channel through his burst to chunk him. The thing to dodge is his E root (he procs it off Q poke) — bait it, block the follow-up burst with your W damage reduction, then commit while his root is down.
edits.after: Level 1 you only have Bladesurge and no stun, so respect Overload poke and farm off the wave — don't dash in for one auto inside Rune Prison's 615 range. The trade flips at Level 3: Flawless Duet stuns, Bladesurge resets off the Mark, and you stick to a champion with no dash. Rune Prison only roots you if Spell Flux has debuffed you first, and it is down 10.5s at rank 2 — bait it, then commit. Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only, so it does nothing against his magic burst.

edits.before: This is your takeover window. Your Bladesurge passive is stacking, cooldowns tighten, and at 6 your R is the answer to a mage who wants to kite and shield — fire Vanguard's Edge behind him so he can't Flash or walk out of the lane, then E-stun and chain Q-resets while your max-stack passive shreds his MR. He has no dash and a pre-item Ryze can't out-trade your sustained DPS once you're glued to him. Hold W to eat his Q-into-E burst, then all-in when his root is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your takeover window. Your passive is stacking, cooldowns tighten, and at 6 your R answers a mage who lives on distance — fire Vanguard's Edge behind him so the wall cuts off his walk-out, then stun with Flawless Duet and chain Bladesurge resets off the Mark while max stacks pour on-hit damage in. He has no dash and a pre-item Ryze can't out-trade your sustained DPS once you're glued to him. Don't hold Defiant Dance for his burst — it reduces physical damage only and Ryze deals magic. All-in while Rune Prison is down.

edits.before: Ryze is a hard scaler and this is where he reclaims the lane — at 2+ items he free-casts roots from range, his shield eats your opener, and Realm Warp lets him roam and teamfight on his terms. You don't out-scale a fully-itemized Ryze, so your whole game is the lead you built levels 3 through first-item. Convert it into towers and objectives, group and use Vanguard's Edge to wall him off in fights, and close the game before his raid-boss late game eclipses your mid-game spike.
edits.after: Ryze is a hard scaler and this is where he reclaims the lane — at 2+ items he free-casts Rune Prison, Overload resets off every other spell on a 5s base, and Realm Warp (140s at rank 3) moves his whole side into a fight on his terms. You don't out-scale a fully-itemized Ryze, so your whole game is the lead you built levels 3 through first-item. Convert it into towers and objectives, use Vanguard's Edge to cut him off in fights, and close before his late game eclipses your mid-game spike.

edits.after: Use Bladesurge resets off the wave to close the distance Overload opens, then stick to a champion with no dash

edits.after: Poke you down with Overload resets off every other spell so you can never commit a clean all-in at full health

edits.after: Two items on and Ryze free-casts Rune Prison at 615 while Overload chains off it — close the game before his scaling decides it for you.

notes: Three factual errors were shipped on this page. (1) Ryze's root was called his E throughout — it is Rune Prison (W, 615 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) and it only roots if Spell Flux (E) has debuffed the target first; otherwise it slows. (2) Defiant Dance was recommended twice as a way to eat Ryze's burst; Riot's text says it reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge, and Ryze's damage is magic — the player was told to hold a defensive window that does not exist. This matches the mirror audit's finding from Ryze's side. (3) Ryze was credited with a shield in four places and has none in his kit, and Irelia's passive was described as MR shred when it grants stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. Chart flipped in matched pairs on rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 to agree with the packet and the mirror. Not verified from the kits and therefore left alone: whether Rune Prison's root is cleansable/tenacity-reduced, and whether Vanguard's Edge terrain blocks Realm Warp's teleport destination — both are asserted nowhere in Riot's text.
